# For Rent: Hollybrook Residences, Unit 2B

Listed: October 1, 2026

Hollybrook Residences is a three-storey apartment building on a quiet residential street in Fernhill, about fifteen minutes on foot from Fernhill Station. Unit 2B is on the second floor and faces south, so it gets sun for most of the day.
